articles.title: Attackers Breached JetBrains Cadence via Unpatched TeamCity, Extracting AWS Credentials
articles.summary: JetBrains is urging Cadence users to revoke and rotate all credentials following a security incident last month in which unidentified threat actors exploited a recently disclosed critical vulnerability in TeamCity to breach its own environment.
